```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, comment = NA)
options(knitr.kable.NA = "")

bayesplot::color_scheme_set(scheme = "brightblue")
```

```{r}
hhmodel <- housepi::HouseholdModel$new("chain-binomial-heterogeneous")
```

```{r}
dataset <- housepi::survey

dataset$agegroup <- as.integer(dataset$age <= 15)
dataset$susgroup <- dataset$agegroup
dataset$susgroup[(dataset$agegroup == 1) & (dataset$sex == 2)] <- 2

hhmodel$add_group_rate("infectivity", by = "agegroup")
hhmodel$add_group_rate("community_susceptibility", by = "susgroup")
hhmodel$add_group_rate("susceptibility", by = "susgroup")
```

We append the remaining parameter definitions from the template.
```{r}
hhmodel$load_param_template()
```

All other commands stay the same. 
The only difference is that the choice of group rates require model recompilation.
```{r}
hhmodel$infer(dataset, n_steps = 10000, n_adapt = 1000, 
              n_burnin = 1000, thin = 10, progress = FALSE)
```

```{r, fig.width=6, fig.height=6, fig.fullwidth=TRUE, out.height="auto", fig.align="center"}
bayesplot::mcmc_trace(hhmodel$traces)
```
